verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents a Collection Runner and an Inso CLI that runs in CI with pass/fail exit codes. There is no evidence of a built-in scheduled monitor or alerting when an API breaks. Recurring runs and alerts would depend on the user's own CI scheduler and notification setup, which is a host-platform workaround rather than the product's own capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule collection runs as monitors that alert me when an API breaks

citations.quote: Inso CLI is designed to run in a Continuous Integration (CI) environment. It disables prompts and provides exit codes to pass or fail the CI workflow.
Use the Collection Runner to send multiple requests in a specific order
